newsitem.title: POLAND: Kruszwica to revise down 97 net forecast.
newsitem.headline: Kruszwica to revise down 97 net forecast.

text.p: Edible fats maker Kruszwica SA said it will have to revise down its 1997 net profit forecast because a harsh winter wiped out much of Poland's rapeseed crops and drove up prices, the Parkiet daily said on Friday.
"Everything indicates that this year's net will be lowered," Finance Director Henryk Lament was quoted as saying.
Kruszwica has said it expects a net profit of 12.6 million zlotys in 1997 after a 3.4-million-zloty net last year.
Kruszwica said it would give its new net forecast at the end of April. Firm officials were not immediately available for comment.
